name: VIB Vermogen AG
summary: VIB Vermögen AG develops, buys, holds, and manages commercial real estate properties in Southern Germany. As of December 31, 2019, its real estate portfolio comprised 109 logistics and light industry properties, and specialist retail parks, as well as commercial and service centers with a total rentable area of approximately 1.16 million square meters. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Neuburg an der Donau, Germany.
